newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sells 5-yr notes at high yield of 6.616 pct. [CORRECTED 21:36 GMT]
newsitem.headline: U.S. sells 5-yr notes at high yield of 6.616 pct. [CORRECTED 21:36 GMT]

text.p: The U.S. Treasury said Thursday its Dutch auction of $12.001 billion of five-year bills produced a high yield of 6.616 percent. It said it awarded 37 percent of bids at the high.
The interest rate on the bills will be 6-1/2 percent.
The median yield was 6.6 percent and the low yield was 6.5 percent.
A total of $33.385 billion in bids were received, including $738 (corrects figure from $378) million in noncompetitive bids from the public.
The bills will be issued June 2 and mature May 31, 2002.
The high yield was down from 6.745 percent at the last auction of five-year notes on April 23 and was the lowest since 6.359 percent on February 26.
